package internalapi

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

type AssignedLessonContextGetter interface {
	Handle(context.Context, string, string, string) (domain.AssignedLessonContext, error)
}

func (handler *Handler) GetAssignedLessonContext(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if handler.AssignedLessons == nil {
		http.Error(w, "assigned lesson context unavailable", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	result, err := handler.AssignedLessons.Handle(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"), chi.URLParam(r, "pathID"), chi.URLParam(r, "itemID"))
	if err != nil {
		switch {
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation):
			http.Error(w, "invalid assigned lesson context", http.StatusBadRequest)
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound):
			http.Error(w, "assigned lesson context not found", http.StatusNotFound)
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict):
			http.Error(w, "ambiguous assigned lesson context", http.StatusConflict)
		default:
			http.Error(w, "assigned lesson context unavailable", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		}
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	// Marshal without the Encoder's extra newline so the checked 2 MiB wire cap
	// includes every response byte.
	encoded, _ := json.Marshal(result)
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	_, _ = w.Write(encoded)
}
